title: 交易心理 | 比预测行情更重要的事：复盘你自己的单子
subTitle:
大部分人花90%的时间预测行情，花0%的时间复盘自己。方向反了。

每笔单子记三行字：为什么开（依据是什么）、哪里错/对（执行层面）、
下次怎么改（具体动作）。坚持一个月，你会震惊地发现：你亏损的
单子里有大量「同一类错误」在反复出现——比如总是止损后立刻反手、
总是盈利单拿不住。

行情会变，但你的行为模式不会自动变，除非你盯着它改。市场是最
诚实的老师，你的交割单就是成绩单。别只看账户余额，去翻交易记录。

你怎么看？评论区聊聊你的经历。
#交易心理 #复盘 #BTC #ETH

translatedData.title: Trading Psychology | What's More Important Than Predicting the Market: Reviewing Your Own Trades
translatedData.subTitle:
Most people spend 90% of their time predicting the market and 0% reviewing their own trades. They've got it backwards.

Write down three things for every trade: why you entered (what was your rationale?), what went right or wrong (in terms of execution),
and what you'll do differently next time (specific actions). Stick with it for a month, and you'll be shocked to discover: your losses
The same kinds of mistakes keep showing up in your trades—for example, always reversing your position right after a stop-loss,
or never holding on to winning trades.

Market conditions change, but your behavior patterns won't change on their own unless you keep an eye on them and work to change them. The market is the most
honest teacher, and your trade history is your report card. Don't just look at your account balance—go through your trading records.

ETHEREUM (ETH): INSTITUTIONAL ADOPTION IS GROWING — CAN PRICE FOLLOW?

Ethereum is showing renewed momentum as institutional interest in digital asset infrastructure continues to develop.

ETH gained approximately 3% during Asian trading on October 19, outperforming Bitcoin's 1.4% gain during the same period.

Another development worth watching is Deutsche Bank's upcoming digital asset custody service. The bank plans to initially support Bitcoin and Ether before expanding into additional blockchain-based financial services.

WHY THIS MATTERS

Institutional custody infrastructure can make digital assets more accessible to traditional financial institutions. However, adoption does not automatically translate into immediate buying pressure for ETH.

POTENTIAL ENTRY AREA

Watch for a retest of the nearest confirmed support zone following ETH's recent advance.

CONFIRMATION

Look for a bullish market structure shift on the 5M or 15M timeframe, supported by stronger buying volume.

INVALIDATION

Reassess the bullish scenario if ETH loses the relevant support and fails to reclaim it.

MARKET SIGNAL: CAUTIOUSLY BULLISH

ETH's relative strength and expanding institutional infrastructure are encouraging, but sustained momentum still needs confirmation. Avoid chasing a sharp move without checking price structure.

The key question is whether buyers can maintain control after the initial rally.
